hoverOrTapToRead: Hover or tap to read a value

sourceDoefinApiNoProduction: Source: Doefin API. No production estimate is shown without a network baseline.
refreshUnavailableTheFiguresBelow: Refresh unavailable. The figures below use the last available reading.
refreshToCheckTheLatest: Refresh to check the latest network baseline.
exampleMinerPhSFor: Example miner: {hashrate} PH/s for {hours} hours at 100% uptime. Block subsidy only; transaction fees and pool fees excluded. Difficulty and subsidy stay fixed during each scenario.

expectedBtcProductionMinerHashrate: Expected BTC production = miner hashrate in hashes per second × period in seconds × block subsidy ÷ (difficulty × 2³²).
impliedNetworkHashrateUsesDifficulty: Implied network hashrate uses difficulty × 2³² ÷ 600 seconds. It is not a direct network measurement. Actual production varies.
thisIsNotAForecast: This is not a forecast of trading returns.

asAMinerIThink: As a miner, I think about network difficulty every day. This tool gives me a way to hedge and trade that risk instead of just accepting it.
